name: frontal-gtm
description: Go-to-market plugins for Claude Code: an outbound pipeline, a GTM content library, Slack/Discord/webhook pings, and a best-effort guard that asks before calls that look like your sales tools sending, spending credits or changing records.

plugins.name: gtm-outbound
plugins.description: Outbound pipeline: signal research, lead scoring, prospect profiles, first lines, sequences, reply triage, meeting prep and pipeline reviews, run by seven subagents. Drafts to files; nothing is sent without you.

plugins.name: gtm-content
plugins.description: 17 GTM content prompts as one skill: case studies, ICP cards, LinkedIn carousels, one-pagers, pitch decks, proposals, pricing pages and scopes of work, written from facts you supply.

plugins.name: gtm-notify
plugins.description: Pings Slack, Discord or any webhook (Zapier, n8n, Make, Clay) when Claude finishes or needs you, with Claude's real message in the ping.

plugins.name: gtm-guard
plugins.description: A best-effort check that makes Claude ask before sales-tool calls that look like sending email, launching sequences, spending enrichment credits, changing CRM records or deleting data, and logs each such call. A safety net, not a guarantee.
